protocol.compiler: product v7; neutral trace-presence sentence shared across arms
protocol.selection: same 12 development cases as prior trace ablation; no new holdout claim
protocol.controls: identical frozen facts, actors, post-simulation decisions, model, branch slots and four-branch budget; only simulated_actions changes
protocol.watchlist_rule: observable_trigger AND specific_invalidation AND evidence_grounded, true in both judge passes
protocol.strict_rule: all five existing qualification flags true in both passes
protocol.semantic_direction_guard: all arms need at least 80% flag agreement and score-within-one agreement; otherwise semantic direction is inconclusive
protocol.pilot_expansion_gate: all nine outputs and eighteen judgments must be valid; quality direction is not a selection criterion
protocol.request_bounds: 30000 UTF-8 prompt bytes and 5000 output tokens; reserve conservative dollar cost before every request, including in-flight calls
protocol.budget_note: token cap checked before dispatch; up to three in-flight requests can exceed the threshold
protocol.privacy: reuse existing identifier/date/source anonymization for all outbound prompts
limitations: model judging is not human adoption
reuses completed simulations; excludes their sunk cost
does not test removal of the interaction process
one generation draw; development cases; no accuracy or return evaluation
